title: Programs call psionic operators 'pink assets'

tellings.quote: And granted, that is something that has been communicated to me is yes, that some of the programs refer to them as that.

plain: Some secret programmes, said to deal with non-human craft, are claimed to call their "psionic" operators, people said to use their minds to sense or influence such craft, by the code name "pink assets". Michael Herrera, a guest who says he saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, tells Michels this was passed on to him, and he names a man called Jake Barber in connection with it. If true, it would mean these programmes use mental abilities as a working tool and have their own slang for the people who have them.
